news.title: One hurt as gunfire probe centers on DeKalb County mall
news.summary: Investigators swarmed a Decatur commercial corridor Tuesday afternoon after a reported shooting victim arrived near South DeKalb Mall with non-life-threatening injuries, according to police.

news.title: Man shot, killed by his son at metro Atlanta home, police say
news.summary: The victim of a deadly shooting in DeKalb County on Monday morning was identified.

news.title: Woman found dead inside Loews Atlanta hotel room, man charged with murder
news.summary: Police responded to the hotel in midtown Atlanta on Oct. 14. They entered one of the rooms and found a woman dead inside of it. Family identified the woman as Melissa Tibbetts.

news.title: Man arrested after woman found dead at Midtown Atlanta hotel
news.summary: Atlanta police arrested a 39-year-old man on murder charges after hotel staff discovered a woman dead inside a Midtown luxury hotel room in mid-October.

news.title: DNA evidence leads to life sentence for rape a decade after crime
news.summary: A Henry County jury has convicted Marlon Freeman of rape in connection with a sexual assault that occurred in May 2016.

news.title: Man charged with murder after woman found dead inside Loews Atlanta Hotel room, police say
news.summary: According to authorities, Emmanuel Poindexter was arrested for the death of Melissa Tibbetts.

news.title: VIDEO: Atlanta Police asking for help to identify shoplifting suspect who threatened employee, officers say
news.summary: The incident happened on October 23 in the Campbellton Road area.

news.title: 49-year-old man allegedly killed by son on Monday in DeKalb County
news.summary: An adult victim died after being shot on Springfair Run, DeKalb County police said.
